notes: Two single points are needed for Delta E: relax_i and the neutral form (relax_ii if it stays on O5, otherwise the constrained relax_iifix).  Because PBE biases acid-base crystals towards the salt (LeBlanc et al. 2018, doi:10.1002/anie.201809381), this hybrid check is what tests the PBE conclusion.  A hybrid relaxation would cost roughly the per-point figure times the number of BFGS steps and is not proposed.
nq 1x1x1 is the usual cheap choice for an insulator with a 3x2x2 k grid; the QE 7.5 default (nq = k grid) is ~12x dearer.
